notes.title: Update v0.62
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257452/512bd07e846d07bc775fad4a20b7ca5bb46a2125.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Update v0.62[/p][p]• Added 3 new drones[/p][p]• Added 16 new tracks[/p][p]• Added quick map and drone switching options in the pause menu of FreeFlight mode[/p][p]• Added a 2x slow-motion option to the slow-motion feature[/p][p]• Improved the visual effects of AI drones in Race mode[/p][p]• Adjusted the display effects of some drones under the analog video effect[/p][p]• Fixed display bugs for obstacles on certain tracks[/p]

notes.title: Update v0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257452/62d19f62d78829eb2d4a86fa87833f78aae19bab.jpg[/img]
• Added support for MacOS
• Updated Factory 1 map
• Added trail feature
• Added observer view feature
• Added tips
• Added a mini-game: Balloon Buster
• Updated drone sound system
• Fixed cursor offset issue in fullscreen mode
• Fixed some blurry textures
• Fixed parameter alignment issue under actual and RF rates
• Fixed collision bugs with some interactive objects
• Fixed display error of the starting gate in racing mode
• Fixed issue with entering the stadium scene on devices with 8GB RAM
• Optimized overall memory usage

notes.title: Update V0.550
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257452/80a710a7e90b351f7cd6f2248c5c50f5ff4d2d9b.jpg[/img]
• Added a new map “Factory-2”

• Fixed the problem of the chase view camera penetrating the ground when colliding .

notes.title: Update V0.53
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257452/7dbdd36dc046d993d4b71ac0e1d8d6f75e467d66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257452/7c2fc02198d99d9cb36158e92fc76bd872613e6a.png[/img]

• Added 10 new racing tracks
• Fixed an issue with incorrect yaw rotation values in angle mode and altitude hold modes

notes.title: Update v0.520
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44257452/31c78d7548f85279c315b31df69cc723c422686b.png[/img]
• Added HGLRC 1S toothpick "Drashark"
• Added Actual Rates/Raceflight Rates/KISS Rates

• Factory map slightly updated

notes.title: Update V0.514
notes.content:
• Added the function of automatically hiding the mouse during flight
• Fixed the issue where the race could not be reset using the controller button after finishing in racing mode
• Fixed the issue where channels were repeatedly recognized during remote control settings
• Fixed the issue where the button sequence number on the remote control settings interface was incorrect

notes.title: Update V0.513
notes.content:
Changelist V0.513:
• Fixed the bug where dragging the camera tilt value in the parameter panel in the flight scene would cause a crash.
• Fixed the issue where connecting a remote control mid-game would not refresh the remote control configuration.
• Fixed the chase view camera.
• Fixed the issue where switching flight modes with the keyboard was ineffective.
• Angle mode is available, and the two Angle mode parameters in the flight control settings are available. 
Altitude hold mode is available.
